hooks.command: payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *"git commit"*) b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" != "feature/nucleation-classifier" ]; then printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Blocked: commits are restricted to branch feature/nucleation-classifier (current: %s). Switch branches, or edit the allowed branch in .claude/settings.local.json.\"}}" "${b:-detached HEAD}"; fi;; esac; exit 0
enabled=false; if [ "$enabled" = "true" ]; then python "$HOME/.claude/skills/context-graph/scripts/context_lookup.py" --orphans; fi; exit 0
